name: @quartz-community/plugin-rucksack
description: Rucksack plugin for Quartz v5: stash anything inside a fenced block into a localStorage/IndexedDB-backed pack.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test

storageKey.description: Database name and localStorage namespace for this rucksack.

title.description: Label shown on the rucksack toggle button.

icon.description: Glyph shown next to the title.

languages.description: Fence languages that can be stashed. "*" (default) stashes every fenced block.

excludeLanguages.description: Fence languages to skip, e.g. ["ts", "js"] to keep code snippets out.

removeFromDom.description: Remove a block from the page when it is stashed (default), or leave it in place and mark it.

merge.description: Merge same-named blocks stashed on other pages into one row.

parseDetails.description: Read quantity (x3) and location (Location: …) hints from the fence.

nameAttribute.description: Read the name from this attribute instead of the block's first line.

maxNameLength.description: Name length shown in full before the UI elides it.

sound.description: Play a sound when something is stashed or unstashed.

logEvents.description: Log emitted stash events to the browser console.

stashLabel.description: Label on a block's button while it is not stashed.

stashedLabel.description: Label on a block's button while it is stashed.
